//: `pnpm typecheck` reads this file. It checks the branch's own code and leaves out what Next generates (.next/types, .next/dev/types and next-env.d.ts, which imports them). A reused worktree keeps those files from whichever tree `next dev` or `next build` last ran on, so they can name routes this branch lacks (T-258). GitHub CI typechecks before any of them exist, so it reads the same files. Editors and Next read tsconfig.json, which keeps Next's route types.
